decisions.reason: As a close-to-core door lever handle family that survived the initial portfolio shakeout, it likely has proven demand and low carrying cost within the firm's broad catalogue, so keeping it is more valuable than freeing limited additional resources.

This handle design is more exposed to style turnover and assortment rationalization than a full family, but as a design-led core product with manageable continuation costs it still merits staying on the market unless sales clearly deteriorate.

The electronic access system fits the firm's strategic move toward integrated digital building solutions and remains a differentiated innovation, so despite higher support costs its option value and strategic relevance argue for continuation.
